title: Kahaani 2: Durga Rani Singh
desc: As Inspector Inderjeet investigates the car accident, he discovers that Vidya Sinha may not be all she appears. She has a dark past linking her to Durga Rani Singh.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: Border 2
desc: Tensions between East and West Pakistan cause migrants to cross into India. India supports Bengali independence. Pakistan attacks. Four soldiers trained by Fateh Singh defend land, air, and sea.

title: Mrs.
desc: Richa thought she found total bliss marrying doctor Diwakar, but domestic routine suffocates her spirit until she finally decides to battle subtle household patriarchy and rebuild her identity.

title: Ghoomer
desc: Anina, a young cricket star, loses her right hand before her debut. With help from a failed cricketer and creative training, she becomes a bowler and invents a new style.

title: Jaat
desc: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Kismat Konnection
desc: Raj, a struggling architect, and Priya, a disillusioned activist, cross paths. Destiny connects them in surprising ways, leading to love, hope, and a chance at new beginnings.

title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Behen Hogi Teri
desc: A man deeply loves a girl everyone insists he treat as a sister, but he refuses to bow to the rule and boldly decides to stand up and fight for his love.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Amar and Prem are broke dreamers chasing the same rich heiress, Raveena, but their silly feud gets wildly out of hand after crossing paths with dangerous gangster Teja.

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.

title: Singham Again
desc: When ruthless enemies kidnap his beloved wife, fearless police officer Bajirao Singham rallies his trusted force to execute a high-stakes, explosive rescue mission and bring justice.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl who is speech-impaired lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she is from Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Kites
desc: Jay, a Las Vegas dance teacher, marries women for green cards. He weds Natasha for the same reason but unexpectedly falls in love when they reunite, complicating his plans.

title: Mili
desc: Mili Naudiyal works in a restaurant while preparing to move to Canada. Her life turns into a survival battle when she's accidentally locked inside a freezer.
